-- CA-1: LaMalfa died Jan 6, 2026. Special election Aug 4 for current seat.
-- New redrawn CA-1 general election: Mike McGuire (D) vs TBD R (top-2 primary not yet held)
-- Set to Scheduled since CA primary hasn't occurred, and update candidates
UPDATE house_races 
SET candidate1_name = 'Mike McGuire',
    candidate1_party = 'D',
    candidate2_name = NULL,
    candidate2_party = 'R',
    status = 'Scheduled',
    notes = 'CA top-2 primary June 2026. D: Mike McGuire (CA Senate leader). R TBD. Special election for current seat Aug 4, 2026.'
WHERE state_code = 'CA' AND district = 1;

SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status, notes
FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'CA' AND district = 1;
